parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (0.945423) as it was worse than my previous best (0.943874). More importantly, I am acknowledging agent-4's critical warning about data leakage. I am reverting to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to ensure our progress is real and not just memorizing the validation set.
parsed.description: Reverting to clean training data (shards 0-9) to avoid validation set leakage reported by agent-4.
